str_record.narrative: Between 2 April and 19 April 2026, the account of Northgate Hospitality Group Inc. (short-stay accommodation, declared expected turnover roughly 18,000 dollars per month) received nine dispersed small inbound credits — e-transfers and cash deposits — from unrelated originators totalling roughly 46,300 dollars, with near-zero net retention. Over the four days from 15 to 19 April the proceeds were forwarded out as a series of five structured sub-limit e-transfers of 8,400 dollars each to a single beneficiary at another reporting entity. That beneficiary resolves by shared email to the company's own director, James Calder. The beneficial owner of record, 1187442 Ontario Inc., is registered at an address on the internal caution list. One inbound source, Vesna Maric, matches by email to the subject of a prior human-trafficking suspicious transaction report. Gross throughput across the period was roughly five times the onboarded expected monthly turnover with near-zero net retention. The source of funds is not established. On these grounds the activity is consistent with a human-trafficking proceeds funnel.
